text:
If A + B means ‘A’ is the husband of ‘B’, A – B means ‘A’ is the wife of ‘B’, A × B means
‘A’ is the mother of ‘B’, A ÷ B means ‘A’ is the son of ‘B’. If J ÷ P + K × M – R, then How
is P related to R?

explanation.text:
Decode J ÷ P + K × M – R step by step:
- J ÷ P: J is the son of P.
- P + K: P is the husband of K.
- K × M: K is the mother of M, so P (K's husband) is M's father.
- M – R: M is the wife of R.
So P is the father of M, and M is R's wife. Therefore P is R's **wife's father** (father-in-law), option D.
Why not the others: P is not R's husband or father, and "wife's brother" would need P to be M's sibling.

textHi:
दिए गए वाक्य में उचित विशेषण का चयन करके रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति करें।
महाराज जी के चर्चे तो ______ लोकों में फैले हुए हैं।

explanation.text:
रिक्त स्थान के बाद ‘**लोकों**’ (बहुवचन संज्ञा) आया है, इसलिए यहाँ ऐसा विशेषण चाहिए जो इसकी संख्या बताए और बहुवचन के साथ मेल खाए।

‘**तीनों**’ संख्यावाचक (निश्चित संख्यावाचक, समुदायबोधक) विशेषण है। ‘तीनों लोक’ (स्वर्ग, पृथ्वी, पाताल) एक प्रचलित प्रयोग है, जिससे वाक्य बनता है: महाराज जी के चर्चे तो **तीनों लोकों** में फैले हुए हैं, अर्थात उनकी प्रसिद्धि हर जगह है।

अन्य विकल्प क्यों गलत हैं:
- **स्वभाव**: यह संज्ञा है, विशेषण नहीं।
- **प्रत्येक**: यह एकवचन के साथ आता है (‘प्रत्येक लोक में’), ‘लोकों’ के साथ नहीं।
- **जिसको**: यह संबंधवाचक सर्वनाम है, विशेषण नहीं।

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प A ‘तीनों’ है।

answer.label: A

text:
निम्नलिखित शब्द का संधि विच्छेद करें।
प्रमाण
textHi:
निम्नलिखित शब्द का संधि विच्छेद करें।
प्रमाण

explanation.text:
‘**प्रमाण**’ का संधि विच्छेद है **प्र + मान**।

यह व्यंजन संधि के **णत्व विधान** का उदाहरण है: जब ‘ऋ, र, ष’ के बाद (बीच में स्वर, कवर्ग, पवर्ग, य, व, ह आदि आएँ तो भी) ‘न’ आता है, तो ‘न’ का ‘ण’ हो जाता है।

प्र (र युक्त उपसर्ग) + मान → ‘र’ के बाद आए ‘न’ का ‘ण’ → **प्रमाण**।

इसी प्रकार: प्र + मान = प्रमाण, परि + नाम = परिणाम, राम + अयन = रामायण।

अन्य विकल्प क्यों गलत हैं:
- **पर + मान**: ‘पर’ से ‘परमान’ बनेगा, ‘प्रमाण’ नहीं; उपसर्ग ‘प्र’ है।
- **प्रा + माण**: ‘प्रा’ में दीर्घ ‘आ’ है, जो ‘प्रमाण’ में नहीं है।
- **परम + अण**: इससे ‘परमाण’ जैसा रूप बनेगा, जो सही नहीं है।

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प C ‘प्र + मान’ है।

answer.label: C

- **प्रार्थना**: यह भी संज्ञा है, पर ‘प्रार्थना से सबका दिल जीत लिया’ भाव की दृष्टि से स्वाभाविक नहीं है; किसी के आते ही दिल जीतने का कारण उसका प्रेमपूर्ण व्यवहार होता है।

दिए गए वाक्य में उचित कारक का चयन करके रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति करें।

textHi:
दिए गए वाक्य में उचित कारक का चयन करके रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति करें।
मिठाई ______ डब्बे में से एक मिठाई निकालकर ले आओ।

explanation.text:
यहाँ ‘मिठाई’ और ‘डब्बे’ के बीच **संबंध कारक** चाहिए (मिठाई वाला डब्बा)। संबंध कारक के चिह्न का, के, की अगले शब्द के लिंग, वचन और रूप के अनुसार बदलते हैं।

‘डब्बा’ पुल्लिंग है, लेकिन वाक्य में इसके बाद परसर्ग ‘में से’ आया है, इसलिए यह विकारी रूप ‘**डब्बे**’ में है। विकारी (तिर्यक) रूप वाले पुल्लिंग शब्द से पहले संबंध कारक ‘का’ बदलकर ‘**के**’ हो जाता है।

सही वाक्य: मिठाई **के** डब्बे में से एक मिठाई निकालकर ले आओ।

अन्य विकल्प क्यों गलत हैं:
- **का**: अविकारी रूप ‘डब्बा’ के साथ आता (मिठाई का डब्बा), ‘डब्बे में’ के साथ नहीं।
- **में** और **पर**: अधिकरण कारक के चिह्न हैं; ‘मिठाई में डब्बे’ या ‘मिठाई पर डब्बे’ का कोई अर्थ नहीं बनता।

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प C ‘के’ है।

text:
निम्नलिखित शब्द का संधि विच्छेद करें।
इत्यादि
textHi:
निम्नलिखित शब्द का संधि विच्छेद करें।
इत्यादि

explanation.text:
‘**इत्यादि**’ का संधि विच्छेद है **इति + आदि**।

यह **यण् स्वर संधि** का उदाहरण है। यण् संधि में यदि इ/ई, उ/ऊ या ऋ के बाद कोई भिन्न (असमान) स्वर आए, तो इ/ई का ‘य्’, उ/ऊ का ‘व्’ और ऋ का ‘र्’ हो जाता है।

इति + आदि: ‘ति’ के ‘इ’ के बाद ‘आ’ आया, इसलिए इ → य्; त् + य् + आ = ‘त्या’ → **इत्यादि**।

इसी प्रकार: यदि + अपि = यद्यपि, अति + अधिक = अत्यधिक।

अन्य विकल्प क्यों गलत हैं: ‘इत’, ‘इट’ और ‘इद:’ हिंदी/संस्कृत में सार्थक शब्द नहीं हैं, और इनसे यण् संधि का नियम लागू नहीं होता।

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प D ‘इति + आदि’ है।

प्रश्न में वह कथन पूछा गया है जो गद्यांश में **नहीं** है (या गद्यांश के विपरीत है)।

गद्यांश स्पष्ट कहता है कि रात की गतिविधि अपनाने से आइबेक्स भेड़ियों जैसे शिकारियों के प्रति संवेदनशील हो रहे हैं और ‘इस प्रक्रिया में **शिकार के जोखिम बढ़ रहे हैं**’। विकल्प B कहता है कि जोखिम ‘**कम** हो रहे हैं’, जो गद्यांश के उलट है। इसलिए B सही उत्तर है।

अन्य विकल्प गद्यांश में दिए गए तथ्य हैं:

- **D**: ‘गर्म दिनों से बचने के लिए दैनिक आदतों को रात की आदतों में बदलने के लिए मजबूर हैं’ गद्यांश में है।

(प्रश्न में ‘नहीं हें’ छपा है, जिसका शुद्ध रूप ‘नहीं है’ है।)

text:
In which of the following type of addressing mode, the instruction specifies a register
in the CPU whose contents give the address of the operand in memory?

explanation.text:
In **register indirect** addressing, the instruction names a CPU register, and that register holds the **memory address** of the operand. The CPU reads the address from the register and then fetches the operand from memory. Example: `MOV A, @R0` in 8051, or `LOAD (R1)`.

- Implied mode: the operand is implicit in the opcode (e.g. CMA).
- Immediate mode: the operand itself is inside the instruction.
The answer is option A.

text:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct regarding Assembly language?
I. An assembler converts (or assembles) the symbolic program of an Assembly
language into its equivalent machine program.
II. A program written in an assembly language is machine dependent.

explanation.text:
Both statements are correct.
- **I**: An **assembler** translates a program written with symbolic mnemonics (MOV, ADD, JMP) and symbolic addresses into the equivalent binary machine-language program. This translation is called assembling.
- **II**: Assembly language is **machine dependent** (low-level): each instruction corresponds closely to a machine instruction of a particular processor family, so a program written for one CPU architecture (say x86) will not run on another (say ARM) without rewriting.
In contrast, high-level languages such as C or Python are largely machine independent and are translated by compilers or interpreters.
The answer is option A.

text:
In Direct Memory Access (DMA) ______, a block sequence consisting of a number of
memory words is transferred in a continuous burst.

explanation.text:
A DMA controller can transfer data in two main ways:
- **Burst transfer**: a block of several memory words is transferred in one **continuous burst** while the DMA controller holds the system buses; the CPU is idle on the bus until the block is done. This suits fast devices such as disks.
- **Cycle stealing**: the DMA controller transfers **one word at a time**, then returns bus control to the CPU, "stealing" occasional memory cycles.
Why not the others: bus granting (BG) is the CPU's signal that it has released the buses, and the count register only tracks how many words remain.

anomaly in Operating System?

text:
Which of the following is correct formula for calculating wavelength (λ) of a signal in
the data communication?

explanation.text:
Wavelength is the distance a simple signal travels in one complete cycle. In one period T the signal moves a distance equal to (propagation speed × T), so:
- **λ = propagation speed × period**
- Since period T = 1/f, this is the same as **λ = propagation speed ÷ frequency** (λ = c/f).
Example: a 2 Hz signal in a medium where it travels 2×10⁸ m/s has λ = 2×10⁸ × 0.5 = 10⁸ m.
Why not the others:
- Adding speed to frequency or period (A, C) is dimensionally meaningless.
- Speed × frequency (D) is wrong; frequency must divide, not multiply.

text:
In periodic analog signals, which of the following is NOT a parameter to describe a sine
wave in data communication?

explanation.text:
In data communication (Forouzan), a periodic analog sine wave is fully described by **three parameters**:
- **Peak amplitude**: the highest intensity of the signal (e.g. volts).
- **Frequency**: the number of cycles per second (the inverse of the period).
- **Phase**: the position of the waveform relative to time 0.
**Wavelength** is a derived characteristic: it depends on the frequency and on the propagation speed of the medium (λ = speed × period). It is therefore not one of the three basic parameters used to describe a sine wave, so option A is the answer.

text:
In SQL, which of the following is correct command for schema evolution, if the
RESTRICT option is chosen than the schema is dropped only if schema has no
element in it?

explanation.text:
Schema evolution commands in SQL (Elmasri–Navathe) include DROP and ALTER. A whole schema is removed with:
`DROP SCHEMA COMPANY CASCADE;` or `DROP SCHEMA COMPANY RESTRICT;`
- With **CASCADE**, the schema and all its elements (tables, domains, views) are removed.
- With **RESTRICT**, the schema is dropped **only if it has no elements** in it; otherwise the command fails.
So the command described is **DROP**.
Why not the others: DELETE removes rows from a table, UPDATE changes row values, and ALTER modifies an existing table definition (e.g. adding a column); none of them removes a schema.

text:
Unicode in the programming language can be represented using which of the bit
format standards in computer science?

explanation.text:
Unicode characters are stored using the Unicode Transformation Formats, which are built on **8-bit, 16-bit and 32-bit** code units:

text: What is the ratio of the stock of money to the stock of high powered money in an economy called?
textHi: किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में मुद्रा के स्टॉक का शक्तिशाली मुद्रा के स्टॉक के अनुपात को क्या कहा जाता है?

explanation.text:
High powered money (H), also called reserve money or the monetary base, consists of currency held by the public plus reserves of commercial banks with the central bank. Banks create credit on this base, so the total money supply (M) is a multiple of H.
**Money multiplier = M ÷ H**, the ratio of the stock of money to the stock of high powered money (NCERT Macroeconomics). For example, if H = ₹100 crore and money supply is ₹400 crore, the money multiplier is 4.
'Money supply' is the stock of money itself, not the ratio; 'money exchange' and 'money credit' are not standard terms for this ratio.

concept: P and S seismic waves nature

explanation.text:
Earthquake body waves are of two types (NCERT Geography Class 11):

कथन:
I. कुछ M, B हैं।
II. कोई भी L, M नहीं है।
निष्कर्ष:
I. कोई भी L, B नहीं है।

Statements: Some M are B. No L is M.

text: Raman walks 25 metres in north. He turns right and walks 72 metres to reach point A. He again turns right and walks 16 metres. He finally turns left and walks 8 metres to reach point B. How far is point B from point A and in which direction is starting point from point B?
textHi:
रमन उत्तर में 25 मीटर चलता है। वह दायीं ओर मुड़ता है तथा बिंदु A पर पहुँचने के लिए 72 मीटर चलता है। वह पुनः दायीं ओर मुड़ता है तथा 16 मीटर चलता
है। वह अंततः बायीं ओर मुड़ता है तथा बिंदु B पर पहुँचने के लिए 8 मीटर चलता है। बिंदु B, बिंदु A से कितनी दूरी पर है तथा प्रारंभिक बिंदु, बिदुं B से किस
दिशा में है?

explanation.text:
Take the starting point O as (0, 0), with east = +x and north = +y.

- 25 m north → (0, 25)
- Turn right (now facing east), 72 m → **A = (72, 25)**
- Turn right again (now facing south), 16 m → (72, 9)
- Turn left (now facing east), 8 m → **B = (80, 9)**

**Distance AB:** horizontal gap 80 − 72 = 8, vertical gap 25 − 9 = 16.
AB = √(8² + 16²) = √(64 + 256) = **√320** m (= 8√5 ≈ 17.9 m).

**Direction of O from B:** O (0, 0) is to the left (west) and below (south) of B (80, 9), so the starting point is **South-West** of B.

Why not the others: √340 comes from an arithmetic slip, and North-East is the direction of B from O, the reverse of what is asked. So the answer is option D.

concept: Direction after clockwise and anticlockwise turns

explanation.text:
Walking straight does not change the direction he faces.
- Start: facing **West**.
- 90° clockwise from West → **North**.
- 295° anticlockwise from North: 270° anticlockwise brings him to **East**, and the remaining 25° anticlockwise turns him back towards North.
Final direction: 65° east of north (N65°E), between **north-east (45°)** and **east (90°)**. Net effect: from North, 295° anticlockwise = 65° clockwise.
No option matches exactly. North-east is the closest and is the answer the key expects; it would be exact if the second turn were 315° anticlockwise (315° anticlockwise = 45° clockwise from North). Treat this question as flawed as printed.

text: Which of the following numbers will completely divide (7^29 − 7^30 − 7^31 + 7^32)?
concept: Divisibility of power expressions by factoring

explanation.text:
Take out the smallest power, 7²⁹:

7²⁹ − 7³⁰ − 7³¹ + 7³² = 7²⁹ (1 − 7 − 7² + 7³)
= 7²⁹ (1 − 7 − 49 + 343)
= 7²⁹ × **288**

Alternatively, factor in pairs: 1 − 7 − 49 + 343 = (1 − 7) − 49(1 − 7) = (1 − 7)(1 − 49) = (−6)(−48) = 288.

288 = 2⁵ × 3² and 7²⁹ has only the prime factor 7.

Check the options:
- **72** = 2³ × 3² → divides 288 (288 = 72 × 4) ✓
- 26 = 2 × 13 → needs 13 ✗
- 51 = 3 × 17 → needs 17 ✗
- 78 = 2 × 3 × 13 → needs 13 ✗

So the expression is divisible by 72, option C.

text:
The Highest Common Factor of two numbers is (2/5)th of their Least Common Multiple. If the product of two numbers is 1690, then what is
their Highest Common Factor?
textHi: दो संख्याओं का महत्तम समापवर्तक उनके लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य का (2/5) है। यदि दोनों संख्याओं का गुणनफल 1690 है, तो उनका महत्तम समापवर्तक क्या है?

explanation.text:
For two numbers, **HCF × LCM = product of the numbers**.
Let HCF = h. Then h = (2/5) × LCM, so LCM = 5h/2.
- h × (5h/2) = 1690
- 5h² = 3380 → h² = 676 → **h = 26**
Check: LCM = 5 × 26 / 2 = 65, and 26 × 65 = 1690 ✓; 26 is 2/5 of 65 ✓.
The HCF is **26**.

text:
Cost price and selling price of an article are in ratio of 11 : 16. If cost price is increased by 20 percent and selling price is increased by 20 percent,
then what is the new profit percentage?
textHi:
एक वस्तु का क्रय मूल्य तथा विक्रय मूल्य 11 : 16 के अनुपात में है। यति क्रय मूल्य को 20 प्रतिशत से बढ़ाया जाये तथा विक्रय मूल्य को 20 प्रतिशत से बढ़ाया
जाये, तो नया लाभ प्रतिशत क्या होगा?
concept: Profit % unchanged under equal percentage increase

explanation.text:
Let CP = 11x and SP = 16x.
After a 20% increase in both:
- New CP = 1.2 × 11x = 13.2x
- New SP = 1.2 × 16x = 19.2x
- Profit = 19.2x − 13.2x = 6x
- Profit % = 6x ÷ 13.2x × 100 = 45.45%
Shortcut: increasing CP and SP by the same percentage keeps their ratio 11 : 16, so profit % stays (16 − 11)/11 × 100 = **45.45%**.

text: If a : b = 2 : 3, then what is the value of (b^2 + 2a^2) : (b^2 − 2a^2)?

explanation.text:

b² + 2a² = 9k² + 2(4k²) = 9k² + 8k² = **17k²**
b² − 2a² = 9k² − 2(4k²) = 9k² − 8k² = **k²**

Ratio = 17k² : k² = **17 : 1**

text:
The simple interest received on a certain sum is Rs. 1280 for 4 years. What will be the simple interest on the same at the same rate of interest for

textHi: एक निश्चित राशि पर 4 वर्ष के लिए प्राप्त साधारण ब्याज 1280 रुपये है। समान राशि पर समान ब्याज की दर से 10 वर्ष के लिए साधारण ब्याज कितना होगा?

Simple interest is directly proportional to time when the principal and rate are fixed (SI = P × R × T / 100).
- SI for 4 years = ₹1280

text:
A bus covers a distance of 30 km in 36 minutes. If its speed is decreased by 10 km/hr, then what will be the time taken by it to cover the same
distance?
textHi:
एक बस 30 कि.मी. की एक दूरी को 36 मिनट में तय करती है। यदि उसकी गति को 10 कि.मी./घंटा से कम कर दिया जाए, तो समान दूरी को तय करने म
उसके द्वारा कितना समय लिया जाएगा?

explanation.text:
- Original speed = 30 km ÷ 36 min = 30 km ÷ (36/60 h) = 30 ÷ 0.6 = 50 km/h
- New speed = 50 − 10 = 40 km/h
- New time = 30 ÷ 40 h = 0.75 h = **45 minutes**
So the bus takes 45 minutes to cover the same 30 km.
Shortcut check: time is inversely proportional to speed, so new time = 36 × 50/40 = 45 minutes.

Which of the following statement is correct?
I. A boat travels 84 km downstream and 42 km upstream. If speed of boat and speed of stream are 6 km/hr and 2 km/hr respectively, then total

निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन सही है?

तथा 2 कि.मी./घंटा है, तो लिया गया कुल समय 20 घंटे हैं।
II. एक प्लेटफॉर्म की लम्बाई 1200 मीटर है। यदि एक 600 मीटर लंबी रेलगाड़ी इसे 30 सेकण्ड में पार कर सकती है, तो रेलगाड़ी की गति 54 कि.मी./घंटा है।

**Statement I**: downstream speed = 6 + 2 = 8 km/h, upstream = 6 − 2 = 4 km/h.

**Statement II**: the train must cover its own length plus the platform: 600 + 1200 = 1800 m in 30 s.
- Speed = 1800/30 = 60 m/s = 60 × 18/5 = 216 km/h, not 54 km/h. **False**.
Hence **neither I nor II** is correct.

text: Six times of the volume of a sphere is 29106 cm^3. What will be the ten times of the radius of the sphere?
textHi: एक गोले के आयतन का छह गुना 29106 से.मी.^3 है। गोले की त्रिज्या का 10 गुना क्या होगा?

explanation.text:
- Volume V = 29106 ÷ 6 = 4851 cm³
- (4/3)πr³ = 4851 with π = 22/7 → (88/21) r³ = 4851
- r³ = 4851 × 21 ÷ 88 = 101871 ÷ 88 = 1157.625
- r = ∛1157.625 = **10.5 cm** (since 10.5³ = 1157.625)
Ten times the radius = 10 × 10.5 = **105 cm**.
The other options correspond to radii of 14, 7 and 5.5 cm, which give volumes far from 4851 cm³.

text:
The table given below shows the price (in lakh) of six cars C1, C2, C3, C4, C5 and C6 in three different cities X, Y and Z.
Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct?
I. The ratio of price of C1 in city X to the price of C4 in city Z is 6 : 7 respectively.
II. The ratio of price of C1 in the city X to the price of C4 in city Z is 7 : 6 respectively.
III. Price of C5 is 5 percent more in city Y than the price in city X.
textHi:
नीचे दी गई तालिका तीन अलग-अलग शहरों X, Y तथा Z में छह कारों C1, C2, C3, C4, C5 तथा C6 की कीमत दर्शाती है।
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
I. शहर X में C1 की कीमत और शहर Z में C4 की कीमत का क्रमशः अनुपात 6 : 7 है।
II. शहर X में C1 की कीमत और शहर Z में C4 की कीमत का क्रमशः अनुपात 7 : 6 है।
III. C5 की कीमत शहर Y में शहर X की कीमत से 5 प्रतिशत अधिक है।
concept: Table DI: ratio and percentage increase

explanation.text:
Read the needed values from the table:
- C1 in city X = 3.5 lakh
- C4 in city Z = 3.0 lakh
- C5: city X = 4.0 lakh, city Y = 4.2 lakh

**Statements I and II:** C1 (X) : C4 (Z) = 3.5 : 3.0 = 35 : 30 = **7 : 6**. So II is correct and I (6 : 7, the reverse) is wrong.

**Statement III:** increase from X to Y = 4.2 − 4.0 = 0.2 lakh.
Percentage = 0.2 / 4.0 × 100 = **5%**. So III is correct.

Correct statements: II and III, option B. 'All are correct' is impossible anyway, because I and II contradict each other.

answer.label: B

text:
The line chart given below shows the marked price and selling price of six articles A, B, C, D, E and F.
discount = (Marked price − Selling price)
discount % = (Marked price − Selling price)/Marked price × 100
J1 = Value of sum of discount on articles C and D
J2 = Value of difference of discount on articles D and E
What is the value of J1 − J2?
figureDescription: Line chart for articles A–F: marked price 685, 565, 450, 362, 435, 395 and selling price 615, 525, 425, 318, 420, 350.

explanation.text:
Discount = Marked price − Selling price.

- C: 450 − 425 = **25**
- D: 362 − 318 = **44**
- E: 435 − 420 = **15**

J1 = discount on C + discount on D = 25 + 44 = **69**
J2 = discount on D − discount on E = 44 − 15 = **29**

J1 − J2 = 69 − 29 = **40**

Note that the discount % formula given in the question is not needed here; J1 and J2 use the discount amounts.

Why not the others: 69 is J1 alone, 29 is J2 alone, and 20 would come from a misread value. So the answer is 40, option C.

The line chart given below shows the birth rate (per thousand persons) and death rate (per thousand persons) of countries P, Q, R and S in the year 2018.
Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct?
I. Birth rate of country Q is 9.2 percent more than country R.
II. Birth rate of country R is 11.76 percent more than the birthrate of country S.
III. Birth rate of country Q is 32 percent more than the birth rate of country S.

नीचे दिया गया रेखा चित्र वर्ष 2018 में P, Q, R तथा S देशों की जन्म दर (प्रति हजार व्यक्ति) और मृत्यु दर (प्रति हजार व्यक्ति) को दर्शाता है।

I. Q देश की जन्म दर R देश की जन्म दर से 9.2 प्रतिशत अधिक है।
II. R देश की जन्मदर S देश की जन्म दर से 11.76 प्रतिशत अधिक है।
III. Q देश की जन्मदर S देश की जन्म दर से 32 प्रतिशत अधिक है।

text:
दिए गए वाक्य में से मध्यम पुरूष सर्वनाम ज्ञात किजिए।
तुम्हें दूसरी कक्षा में बुलाया गया हैं।
textHi:
दिए गए वाक्य में से मध्यम पुरूष सर्वनाम ज्ञात किजिए।
तुम्हें दूसरी कक्षा में बुलाया गया हैं।

explanation.text:
पुरुषवाचक सर्वनाम तीन प्रकार के होते हैं:
- **उत्तम पुरुष**: बोलने वाला अपने लिए प्रयोग करे (मैं, हम, मुझे, हमें)
- **मध्यम पुरुष**: जिससे बात की जाए, सुनने वाले के लिए (तू, तुम, आप, तुम्हें, तुमको)
- **अन्य पुरुष**: जिसके बारे में बात की जाए (वह, वे, यह, उसे)

वाक्य ‘तुम्हें दूसरी कक्षा में बुलाया गया है’ में ‘**तुम्हें**’ (तुम + को) सुनने वाले के लिए आया है, इसलिए यह मध्यम पुरुष सर्वनाम है।

अन्य विकल्प क्यों गलत हैं:
- **में**: अधिकरण कारक का परसर्ग है।
- **गया**: क्रिया (सहायक क्रिया) का अंश है।
- **दूसरी कक्षा**: ‘दूसरी’ संख्यावाचक विशेषण और ‘कक्षा’ संज्ञा है।

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प B ‘तुम्हें’ है।

answer.label: B

text: व्यक्ति, स्थान या वस्तुविशेष का बोध करने वाले शब्दों को क्या कहते हैं?
textHi: व्यक्ति, स्थान या वस्तुविशेष का बोध करने वाले शब्दों को क्या कहते हैं?

explanation.text:
जो संज्ञा शब्द किसी **विशेष** व्यक्ति, स्थान या वस्तु का बोध कराते हैं, उन्हें **व्यक्तिवाचक संज्ञा** कहते हैं। जैसे: राम, महात्मा गांधी (व्यक्ति); दिल्ली, गंगा, हिमालय (स्थान); रामायण, ताजमहल (वस्तु)।

अन्य विकल्प क्यों गलत हैं:
- **जातिवाचक संज्ञा**: पूरी जाति या वर्ग का बोध कराती है, किसी एक विशेष का नहीं (जैसे लड़का, नदी, शहर, पुस्तक)।
- **द्रव्यवाचक संज्ञा**: ऐसे पदार्थ या द्रव्य का बोध कराती है जिसे गिना नहीं, नापा-तौला जाता है (जैसे सोना, दूध, पानी, गेहूँ)।
- **समूहवाचक संज्ञा**: किसी समूह या समुदाय का बोध कराती है (जैसे सेना, कक्षा, भीड़, परिवार)।

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प C ‘व्यक्तिवाचक संज्ञा’ है।

textHi: दिए गए शब्दों का सही तत्सम-तद्धव ज्ञात कीजिए।

explanation.text:
तत्सम शब्द संस्कृत से ज्यों-के-त्यों लिए गए शब्द हैं, और तद्भव शब्द वे हैं जो संस्कृत शब्दों से रूप बदलकर हिंदी में आए हैं।

**उपवेष्टन → ओढ़ना** सही तत्सम-तद्भव युग्म है (उपवेष्टन = ऊपर से लपेटना/ढकना)।

अन्य विकल्प क्यों गलत हैं:
- **उलूखल-उल्लू**: ‘उलूखल’ का तद्भव ‘ओखली’ है; ‘उल्लू’ का तत्सम ‘उलूक’ है।
- **कदा-कौन**: ‘कदा’ का तद्भव ‘कब’ है; ‘कौन’ का संबंध ‘कः पुनः’ से माना जाता है।
- **कर्कटक-ककड़ी**: ‘कर्कटक’ का तद्भव ‘केकड़ा’ है; ‘ककड़ी’ का तत्सम ‘कर्कटी’ माना जाता है।

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प D ‘उपवेष्टन-ओढ़ना’ है। (प्रश्न में ‘तद्भव’ के स्थान पर ‘तद्धव’ छपा है।)

textHi: दिए गए शब्दों में शुद्ध वर्तनी का चयन कीजिए।

explanation.text:
**सामूहिक** शुद्ध वर्तनी है। यह शब्द 'समूह' में 'इक' प्रत्यय जोड़कर बना है। 'इक' प्रत्यय लगने पर शब्द के पहले स्वर में वृद्धि होती है (अ → आ), जैसे समाज → सामाजिक, सप्ताह → साप्ताहिक। इसलिए 'स' बदलकर 'सा' हो जाता है। मूल शब्द 'समूह' की बड़ी 'ू' की मात्रा बनी रहती है और 'इक' प्रत्यय के कारण अंत में छोटी 'ि' की मात्रा आती है।
अन्य विकल्प क्यों गलत हैं:
- समूहिक: पहले स्वर में वृद्धि (सा) नहीं हुई।
- समूहीक: वृद्धि नहीं हुई और 'इक' की जगह 'ईक' लिखा गया।
- सामुहीक: 'ू' की जगह 'ु' और 'इक' की जगह 'ईक' लिखा गया।

text: पंडित जवाहर लाल नेहरु का जन्म कब हुआ था?
textHi: पंडित जवाहर लाल नेहरु का जन्म कब हुआ था?
passage:
एक गद्यांश दिया गया है। गद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें तथा प्रश्नों के सही विकल्प चुने।
पंडित जवाहर लाल नेहरू का जन्म 14 नवंबर 1889 को इलाहबाद में हुआ था। उनके जन्मदिन को बाल दिवस के रूप में मनाया जाता है। नेहरू जी को बच्चों से
बड़ा स्नेह था और वे बच्चों को देश का भावी निर्माता मानते थे। बच्चों के प्रति उनके इस स्नेह भाव के कारण बच्चे भी उनसे बेहद लगाव व प्रेम रखते थे और उन्हें
'चाचा नेहरू' कहकर पुकारते थे। यही कारण है कि नेहरू जी के जन्मदिन को बाल दिवस के रूप में मनाया जाता है। इसे नेहरू जयंती कहें या फिर बाल दिवस,
यह दिन पूर्णत: बच्चों के लिए समर्पित है। इस दिन विशेष रूप से बच्चों के लिए कार्यक्रम एवं खेल-कूद से जूड़े आयोजन होते हैं। बच्चे देश का भविष्य हैं, वे ऐसे
बीज के समान हैं जिन्हें दिया गया पोषण उनके विकास और गुणवत्ता निर्धारित करेगा। यही कारण है कि इस दिन बच्चों से जुड़े विभिन्न मुद्दों जैसे शिक्षा, संस्कार,
उनकी सेहत, मानसिक और शारीरिक विकास हेतु जरूरी विषयों पर विचार विमर्श किया जाता है। कई स्कूलों व संस्थानों में बाल-मेला एवं प्रतियोगिताएं भी
आयोजित की जाती हैं, ताकि बच्चों की क्षमता और प्रतिभा को और बढ़ावा मिले। इस दिन विशेष रूप से गरीब बच्चों को मूलभूत सुविधाएं मुहैया कराने एवं बाल
श्रम एवं बाल शोषण जैसे गंभीर मुद्दों पर भी विचार विमर्श किया जाता है। उनका आज, देश के आने वाले कल के लिए बेहद महत्वपूर्ण है। बच्चों को सही शिक्षा,
पोषण, संस्कार मिले य ह देशहित के लिए बेहद अहम है, क्योंकि आज के बच्चे ही कल का भविष्य हैं।

improvement.
Isn’t it time when you focus on your studies?

explanation.text:
The pattern used to say that something should happen now is **'It is (high) time (that) + subject + verb'**, e.g. 'It's time that you focused on your studies.' The conjunction **that** introduces the clause; 'when' is wrong because the sentence is not talking about a point in time at which something happens.
Improved sentence: 'Isn't it time **that** you focus on your studies?'
Why not the others: 'then' is an adverb and cannot introduce the clause; 'which' is a relative pronoun needing a noun antecedent; the original 'when' is not idiomatic here, so 'No improvement' is wrong.

Neither her parents ______ her husband wants to meet her.

**Neither** is always paired with **nor** as a correlative conjunction: 'Neither her parents **nor** her husband wants to meet her.'
Why not the others:
- 'or' pairs with 'either' (either … or).
- 'and' pairs with 'both' (both … and).
- 'not' is not a correlative partner of 'neither'.
Also note subject–verb agreement: with neither … nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject ('her husband' → 'wants').

text: What is the central idea of the given passage?
passage:
Read the following information carefully and answer the given questions.
Initiatives such as “4 per mille” and Terraton aim to sequester huge amounts of carbon in the soil. The 2018 U.S. Farm Bill includes the first-ever
incentives for farmers to adopt practices aimed at improving soil health and sequestering carbon. But these initiatives are missing a key point: not
all soil carbon is the same.
The very different lifetimes of particulate organic matter and mineral-associated organic matter have important implications for these efforts. For
example, adding low-quality crop residues to agricultural fields would likely create more particulate organic matter than mineral-associated
organic matter. This could increase soil carbon in the short term – but if that field later is disturbed by tilling, a lot of it would decompose and the
benefit would be quickly reversed. The best practices focus on building up the mineral-associated organic matter for longer-term carbon storage,
while also producing high-quality particulate organic matter with lots of nitrogen to help boost crop productivity.
Natural healthy soils show us that providing continuous and diverse plant inputs that reach all the way to deep soil is key for achieving both high
mineral-associated organic matter storage and particulate organic matter recycling. There are many promising ways to do this, such as
maintaining plant cover on fields year-round; growing diverse crops that include high-nitrogen legumes and perennials with deep roots; and
minimizing tillage.
However, not all soils can accumulate both mineral-associated organic matter and particulate organic matter. Before implementing any
management practices for carbon sequestration, participants should first assess the carbon storage potential of the local soil, much as a doctor
studies a patient before prescribing a cure. Sequestering soil carbon effectively requires an understanding of how particulate organic matter and
mineral-associated organic matter work, how human actions affect them, and how to build up both types to meet our planet’s climate and food
security needs.

text: If V⃗ = 2yz î + 3xz ĵ + 4xy k̂, then what is the value of ∇.(∇ × V⃗)?

explanation.text:
A standard vector identity says **∇·(∇ × V) = 0** for every vector field with continuous second partial derivatives: the divergence of a curl is always zero. You can also check it directly.
Curl of V = (P, Q, R) = (2yz, 3xz, 4xy):
- î component: ∂R/∂y − ∂Q/∂z = 4x − 3x = x
- ĵ component: ∂P/∂z − ∂R/∂x = 2y − 4y = −2y
- k̂ component: ∂Q/∂x − ∂P/∂y = 3z − 2z = z
So ∇ × V = x î − 2y ĵ + z k̂.
Divergence: ∂(x)/∂x + ∂(−2y)/∂y + ∂(z)/∂z = 1 − 2 + 1 = **0**.
The options −2, 2 and 1 come from slips such as dropping a sign in the curl.

text: If x + iy = tan (A + iB), then what is the value of x^2 + y^2 + 2x cot 2A – 2?
textHi: यदि x + iy = tan (A + iB), तो x^2 + y^2 + 2x cot 2A – 2 का मान क्या है?

explanation.text:
Given x + iy = tan(A + iB), the conjugate gives x − iy = tan(A − iB).
- Adding: tan(A + iB) + tan(A − iB) = 2x
- Multiplying: tan(A + iB)·tan(A − iB) = x² + y²
Use tan(2A) = tan[(A + iB) + (A − iB)] = (sum) ÷ (1 − product):
- tan 2A = 2x ÷ (1 − x² − y²)
- 1 − x² − y² = 2x cot 2A
- **x² + y² + 2x cot 2A = 1**
Therefore x² + y² + 2x cot 2A − 2 = 1 − 2 = **−1**.

text: 1 picoseconds = ______

explanation.text:
The prefix **pico (p)** means 10⁻¹².
So **1 picosecond = 10⁻¹² seconds**.
Other time prefixes:
- milli (ms) = 10⁻³ s
- micro (µs) = 10⁻⁶ s
- nano (ns) = 10⁻⁹ s
- femto (fs) = 10⁻¹⁵ s
- atto (as) = 10⁻¹⁸ s
Option A is a nanosecond, C a femtosecond and D an attosecond.
So the order from largest to smallest is: ms > µs > ns > ps > fs > as, each step being a factor of 1000.

text: What is the maximum running time of binary search algorithm, when n = 12,000?

Binary search halves the search range at every comparison, so the worst-case number of comparisons is **⌊log₂ n⌋ + 1** (equivalently ⌈log₂(n + 1)⌉).
For n = 12,000:
- 2¹³ = 8192 ≤ 12,000 < 16,384 = 2¹⁴
- ⌊log₂ 12000⌋ = 13, so the maximum = 13 + 1 = **14**

text: What is the worst case time complexity of bubble sort?
textHi: बबल सॉर्ट की वर्स्ट केस टाइम कोम्प्लेक्सिटी क्या है?

explanation.text:
Bubble sort repeatedly compares adjacent elements and swaps them if they are out of order. For x elements, in the worst case (reverse-sorted input) it makes (x − 1) + (x − 2) + … + 1 = x(x − 1)/2 comparisons and swaps.
This grows as x², so the worst-case time complexity is **O(x²)**.
Why not the others:
- O(x) is the best case of the optimised version on already sorted input.
- O(log₂ x) is binary search.
- O(x log₂ x) is merge sort or average-case quick sort.

text: How many interchanges will happen when the sequence of letters of “SORTED” is sorted using bubble sort?
textHi: बबल सॉर्ट का उपयोग करते हुए "SORTED" के अक्षरों के क्रम को क्रमबद्ध करने पर कितने इंटरचेंज होंगे?

explanation.text:
In bubble sort every swap fixes exactly one inversion (a pair that is out of order), so the number of interchanges equals the number of inversions.
Letters of SORTED in alphabetical order: D < E < O < R < S < T. Count, for each letter, the later letters that are smaller:
- S: O, R, E, D → 4
- O: E, D → 2
- R: E, D → 2
- T: E, D → 2
- E: D → 1
- D: 0
Total = 4 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 1 = **11** interchanges.

text:
Simplify the following Boolean Expression?
(1 + A).(A + B).(A̅ + B)
textHi: निम्नलिखित बूलियन व्यंजक को सरल कीजिए?

explanation.text:
Simplify step by step:
- (1 + A) = 1 (any variable OR 1 is 1), so the expression becomes (A + B)(A̅ + B).
- Expand: AA̅ + AB + A̅B + BB.
- AA̅ = 0 and BB = B, so this gives AB + A̅B + B.
- AB + A̅B = B(A + A̅) = B, so we have B + B = **B**.
A shortcut uses the distributive law (X + Y)(X + Z) = X + YZ with X = B: (B + A)(B + A̅) = B + AA̅ = B + 0 = B.

text: How many NOR gates are used to get AND gate form them?
textHi: AND गेट बनाने के लिए कितने NOR गेट का उपयोग किया जाता है?

explanation.text:
Use De Morgan's law: A·B = ((A′) + (B′))′.
- NOR gate 1: inputs A, A → output A′ (NOR used as an inverter)
- NOR gate 2: inputs B, B → output B′
- NOR gate 3: inputs A′, B′ → output (A′ + B′)′ = A·B
So **3 NOR gates** are needed to make an AND gate.
For comparison: an OR gate needs 2 NOR gates, a NOT gate needs 1, and a NAND gate needs 4 NOR gates.

text:
A railway crossing has 4 railway tracks. If a train comes on atleast 1 of the tracks, the crossing has to be closed. Which gate can be used to
implement this?
textHi:
एक रेलवे क्रॉसिंग में 4 रेलवे ट्रैक होते हैं, यदि कम से कम 1 ट्रैक पर कोई ट्रेन आती है, तो क्रॉसिंग को बंद करना पड़ता है। इसे लागू करने के लिए किस गेट का
इस्तेमाल किया जा सकता है?

explanation.text:
Let each track have a sensor output: 1 if a train is on it, 0 otherwise. The crossing must close (output 1) if **at least one** input is 1. This is exactly the **OR** function:
Close = T₁ + T₂ + T₃ + T₄
The output is 0 only when all four inputs are 0 (no train anywhere).
Why not the others:
- **AND**: output 1 only if trains are on all four tracks.
- **NOR**: output 1 only when no track has a train (the opposite).
- **NAND**: output 0 only when all four have trains.

text:
Minimize the three variable logic function using the following K-Map.
f(A, B, C) = Sm(0, 2, 5, 7)
textHi:
निम्नलिखित K-Map का उपयोग करके तीन वेरिएबल वाले लॉजिक फ़ंक्शन को मिनीमाइज करें।
f(A, B, C) = Sm(0, 2, 5, 7)
figureDescription: An empty 2×4 K-map grid with AB along the top and C down the side; no cell values are filled in.

explanation.text:
Write the minterms (ABC):
- m0 = 000, m2 = 010, m5 = 101, m7 = 111
Group adjacent 1s on the K-map:
- m0 and m2 (000, 010) differ only in B, so A = 0 and C = 0 give **A̅C̅**.
- m5 and m7 (101, 111) differ only in B, so A = 1 and C = 1 give **AC**.
No larger groups are possible, so f = **A̅C̅ + AC** (the XNOR of A and C), option (B).
Why not the others:
- A̅C̅ + AB covers m6 (110), which is not in the function, and misses m5.
- AC + B covers m2, m3, m6, m7 and misses m0.
- A̅C̅B̅ covers only m0.

text:
Which of the following is an advantage of use of multiplexers?
I. Logic design is simplified
II. Minimizes IC package count
III. Simplification of logic expression is not required
textHi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा मल्टीप्लेक्सर के उपयोग का एक लाभ है?
I. लॉजिक डिजाइन सरलीकृत होता है
II. IC पैकेज संख्या को कम करता है
III. लॉजिक अभिव्यक्ति के सरलीकरण की आवश्यकता नहीं होती है

explanation.text:
Implementing a Boolean function with a multiplexer has these standard advantages (digital electronics textbooks):
- **Logic design is simplified**: the function's truth table is mapped directly onto the data inputs.
- **IC package count is minimised**: one MUX chip can replace several gate ICs, reducing cost and wiring.
- **Simplification of the logic expression is not required**: no K-map or algebraic minimisation is needed.
Other listed advantages include reduced wiring and easier design changes. All three statements are correct: **I, II and III**.

text:
Simplify the following expression.
(A + B + 1).(A̅ + B̅ + 1).(A + B + C).(A̅ + B̅ + C̅)
textHi: निम्नलिखित व्यंजक को सरलीकृत कीजिए।
concept: Boolean simplification of product of sums

explanation.text:
Step 1: any term OR 1 is 1, so (A + B + 1) = 1 and (A̅ + B̅ + 1) = 1. The expression becomes (A + B + C)(A̅ + B̅ + C̅).
Step 2: expand and drop the terms XX̅ = 0 (AA̅, BB̅, CC̅):
AB̅ + AC̅ + A̅B + BC̅ + A̅C + B̅C
Step 3: group the terms:
- AB̅ + B̅C = (A + C)B̅
- A̅B + A̅C = (B + C)A̅
- AC̅ + BC̅ = (A + B)C̅
So the result is **[(A + C)B̅] + [(B + C)A̅] + [(A + B)C̅]**, option (B). It is 1 unless A = B = C.
Why not (C): it drops the C̅ terms. At A = 1, B = 1, C = 0 the original is 1 but (C) gives 0. Options (A) and (D) fail at A = B = C = 1, where the original is 0.

What is equivalent of the following Boolean expression?

textHi: निम्नलिखित बूलियन अभिव्यक्ति के समान क्या है?

The expression is the complement of the whole sum (x + y), that is NOT(x OR y), the NOR function.
By **De Morgan's theorem**, the complement of a sum equals the product of the complements:

Why not the others:

- xy is AND, and x is just one input.

text: JAVA compiler translates source code into ______.
textHi: JAVA कंपाइलर, सोर्स कोड को ______ में ट्रांसलेट करता है।

explanation.text:
The Java compiler (`javac`) translates Java source code (.java files) into **bytecode**, stored in .class files. The **Java Virtual Machine (JVM)** then interprets or JIT-compiles the bytecode into native machine code on each platform, giving Java its 'write once, run anywhere' portability.
Why not the others: Java does not compile to assembly code or to symbolic code, and 'high language code' is what the programmer writes, not the compiler's output.

text: Which page replacement algorithm has Belady’s anomaly?
textHi: बेलेड़ी अनोमाली किस पेज रिप्लेसमेंट एल्गोरिथम में है?

explanation.text:
**Belady's anomaly** is the situation where increasing the number of page frames **increases** the number of page faults for some reference strings. It occurs with **FIFO page replacement**. Classic example: the string 1,2,3,4,1,2,5,1,2,3,4,5 gives 9 faults with 3 frames but 10 faults with 4 frames.
Optimal and LRU are **stack algorithms** (the set of pages in memory with n frames is always a subset of the set with n + 1 frames), so they never suffer from Belady's anomaly.

4 पेज फ़्रेम की क्षमता वाली एक मुख्य मेमोरी पर विचार करें जो प्रारंभ में खाली हैं। यदि पेज रिफरेन्स स्ट्रिंग 1, 3, 4, 4, 3, 2, 1, 7, 5, 6 है, तो एफ. आई. एफ. ओ
पेज रिप्लेसमेंट एल्गोरिथम का उपयोग करके पेज फाल्ट की संख्या क्या है?

explanation.text:
4 frames, FIFO, string 1, 3, 4, 4, 3, 2, 1, 7, 5, 6:
- 1 → fault [1]
- 3 → fault [1,3]
- 4 → fault [1,3,4]
- 4 → hit
- 3 → hit
- 2 → fault [1,3,4,2]
- 1 → hit
- 7 → fault, replace 1 (oldest) → [3,4,2,7]
- 5 → fault, replace 3 → [4,2,7,5]
- 6 → fault, replace 4 → [2,7,5,6]
Total page faults = **7**.

text:
Which of the following method(s) is/are used to measure the aggregate value of goods and services produced in an economy?
I. Expenditure method
II. Income method
III. Product method
textHi:
एक अर्थव्यवस्था में उत्पादित वस्तुओं और सेवाओं के कुल मूल्य को मापने के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी विधि/विधियों का उपयोग किया जाता है/हैं?
I. व्यय विधि
II. आय विधि
III. उत्पाद विधि

explanation.text:
The aggregate value of final goods and services (GDP/national income) can be measured by three methods (NCERT Macroeconomics):
- **Product (value added) method**: sum of value added by all producing units.
- **Income method**: sum of factor incomes (wages, rent, interest, profit).
- **Expenditure method**: sum of final expenditure (consumption, investment, government spending, net exports).
In theory all three give the same value. Hence **I, II and III**.

text:
Which of the following effects of the price change can influence the consumer’s optimal choice?
I. The change in the relative price of a good.
II. The change in the purchasing power of a consumer.
III. Sudden reduction in the minimum support price of a commodity.
textHi:
मूल्य परिवर्तन का निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा प्रभाव उपभोक्ता की इष्टतम विकल्प को प्रभावित कर सकता है?
I. किसी वस्तु की सापेक्ष कीमत में परिवर्तन।
II. किसी उपभोक्ता की क्रय शक्ति में परिवर्तन।
III. किसी वस्तु के न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य में अचानक कमी।
concept: Substitution and income effects of price change

explanation.text:
When the price of a good changes, it affects the consumer's optimal choice through two effects (NCERT Microeconomics):
- **Substitution effect**: the change in the **relative price** of the good makes it cheaper or dearer compared with other goods (statement I).
- **Income effect**: the change in the **purchasing power** (real income) of the consumer (statement II).
Statement III, a cut in the minimum support price, is a government policy affecting farmers' procurement prices; it is not one of the two effects of a price change on the consumer's choice. Hence **I and II**.

The **session layer (layer 5)** establishes, manages and terminates sessions between applications. Its main services (Tanenbaum) are:
- **Dialog control**: keeping track of whose turn it is to transmit (half/full duplex)
- **Token management**: preventing two parties from attempting the same critical operation simultaneously
- **Synchronisation**: checkpointing long transmissions so they can resume after a crash
The transport layer provides end-to-end delivery, the network layer routing, and the physical layer bit transmission.

text:
Which statement is/are true about the OSI model?
I. Layer 1 through 3 are end-to-end
II. Layer 4 through 7 are chained
textHi:
औ.एस.आई. मॉडल के बारे में कौन-सा/से कथन सत्य है/हैं?
I. परत 1 से 3 तक एंड टू एंड ह
II परत 4 से 7 तक चैन्ड़ ह

options.label: D
options.textHi: ना ही I ना ही II

explanation.text:
In the OSI model (Tanenbaum):
- **Layers 1–3 (physical, data link, network) are chained**: each machine talks only to its immediate neighbour, hop by hop, not to the ultimate destination.
- **Layers 4–7 (transport, session, presentation, application) are end-to-end**: a program on the source machine converses with a similar program on the destination machine.
The statements reverse these: I calls layers 1–3 end-to-end and II calls layers 4–7 chained. Both are wrong, so **neither I nor II**.

text:
Which statement is correct regarding binary search tree?
I. The value at node N is less than every value in the left subtree of node.
II. The value at node N is greater than or equal to every value in the right subtree of N.
textHi:
बाइनरी सर्च ट्री के संदर्भ में कौन सा कथन सही है?
I. नोड N पर मान नोड के बाएं सबट्री में प्रत्येक मान से कम है।
II. नोड N का मान N के दाएँ सबट्री में प्रत्येक मान से अधिक या उसके बराबर है।

options.label: D
options.textHi: ना ही I ना ही II

explanation.text:
In a binary search tree, for every node N:
- every value in the **left** subtree is **less than** (or, by some conventions, less than or equal to) the value at N;
- every value in the **right** subtree is **greater than** the value at N.
**Statement I** says N is less than every value in its left subtree: reversed, so false.
**Statement II** says N is greater than or equal to every value in its right subtree: also reversed, so false.
Hence **neither I nor II** is correct.

text:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct regarding about the undirected graph?
I. Number of odd degree vertices is even.
II. Sum of degrees of all vertices is even.
textHi:
अप्रत्यक्ष ग्राफ के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
I. विषम डिग्री के वर्टिसिस की संख्या सम होती है।
II. सभी वर्टिसिस की डिग्री का योग सम होता है।

options.label: D
options.textHi: ना ही I ना ही II

explanation.text:
In any undirected graph, each edge adds 1 to the degree of each of its two end vertices, so (handshaking lemma):
**Σ deg(v) = 2 × (number of edges)**, which is always **even**. Statement II is correct.
Split the sum into even-degree and odd-degree vertices. The sum of even degrees is even, so the sum of odd degrees must also be even; that is possible only if the **number of odd-degree vertices is even**. Statement I is correct.
Hence **both I and II**.

text: Which of the following is not used to calculate Hash functions?
textHi: निम्नलिखित में से किसका उपयोग हैश फ़ंक्शन की गणना के लिए नहीं किया जाता है?

explanation.text:
Common methods for computing a hash function h(k):
- **Division (modular) method**: h(k) = k mod m. 'Modular method' is another name for this.
- **Folding method**: split the key into parts and add them.
- Others: mid-square and multiplication methods.
**Rehashing** is not a way of computing the hash address of a key. It is a **collision-resolution** technique (applying a second hash function when a collision occurs) and also the process of rebuilding a hash table into a larger one when the load factor is high. So the answer is **D**.
DSSSB dropped this question, probably because of a problem in its key.

text:
Which statement(s) is/are correct regarding node N deletion in binary search tree?
I. If node N has no children then just replace location of N in the parent node by the null pointer.
II. If node N has two children, then replace it by preorder successor.
textHi:
बाइनरी सर्च ट्री में नोड N डीलेशन के संदर्भ में कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
I. यदि नोड N की कोई चिल्ड्र न नहीं है, तो पैरेंट नोड में N के स्थान को नल पॉइंटर से बदलें।
II. यदि नोड N के दो चिल्ड्र न हैं तो फिर इसे प्रीऑर्डर सक्सेसर द्वारा प्रतिस्थापित करें।

options.label: D
options.textHi: ना ही I ना ही II

explanation.text:
Deleting a node N from a binary search tree has three cases:
- **No children (leaf):** set the parent's pointer to N to NULL. Statement I is correct.
- **One child:** link N's parent directly to N's only child.
- **Two children:** replace N with its **inorder** successor (smallest node of the right subtree), or its inorder predecessor, then delete that node from its old place.

Statement II says "preorder successor", which is wrong. Only the inorder successor or predecessor keeps the BST ordering (left < node < right), because it is the next larger key. The preorder successor of a node with two children is just its left child, which is smaller than N. Putting it in N's place would break the ordering of N's left subtree.

So only Statement I is correct.

answer.label: A

I. The direction of interaction is from machine to the user.
II. Its domain of knowledge is narrow.

textHi: एक सी.आर.टी पर ओवरलैप किए बिना प्रदर्शित किए जा सकने वाले अंकों की अधिकतम संख्या को ______ कहा जाता है।

explanation.text:
**Resolution** is the maximum number of points (pixels) that a CRT can display without overlap. It is usually given as the number of points per horizontal and vertical direction (e.g. 1024 × 768). It depends on the phosphor, the intensity and the focusing/deflection system.

Why not the others:
- **Persistence:** how long the phosphor keeps glowing after the electron beam is removed (time for the light to fall to 1/10 of its original intensity).
- **Aspect ratio:** the ratio of vertical points to horizontal points needed to draw equal-length lines in both directions.
- **Phosphorescence:** the glow the phosphor gives off after excitation. It is the physical effect, not a measure of how many points can be shown.

text:
Rearrange steps involved in top-down design programming?
I. Analyze the problem
II. Revise and resequence
III. Write the main module
IV. Connect the modules in proper order
V. Write the remaining modules
textHi:
टॉप-डाउन डिज़ाइन प्रोग्रामिंग में शामिल चरणों को पुनर्व्यवसि्थत करें?
I. समस्या का विश्लेषण कर
II. रिवाइज और रिसिकुएंस
III. मुख्य मॉड्यूल लिख
IV. मॉडलों को उचित क्रम में कनेक्ट कर
V. शेष मॉड्यूल लिख

explanation.text:
Top-down design breaks a problem into a main module and smaller sub-modules. The steps follow a logical order:
1. **Analyze the problem (I):** understand what has to be solved.
2. **Write the main module (III):** the top level that outlines the solution and calls the sub-modules.
3. **Write the remaining modules (V):** develop each sub-module.
4. **Connect the modules in proper order (IV):** integrate them under the main module.
5. **Revise and resequence (II):** review the design and refine or reorder it as needed.

This gives **I → III → V → IV → II**, which is option D. The other options start with revising, writing the main module or writing sub-modules before the problem has been analysed, which is not logical.

text: If P is the mean of Poisson distribution, then what is the standard deviation?
textHi: यदि P पॉइसन डिस्ट्रिब्यूशन का माध्य है, तो स्टैंडर्ड मानक क्या है?

explanation.text:
For a Poisson distribution with parameter λ, the **mean and the variance are both equal to λ**.
Here the mean is P, so:
- Variance = P
- Standard deviation = √(variance) = **√P**, option (D).
Why not the others:
- P is the variance (and the mean), not the standard deviation.
- P² and P/2 do not follow from any Poisson property.
The fact that mean = variance is a quick way to recognise Poisson data. For a binomial distribution, by contrast, the variance np(1 − p) is smaller than the mean np.

text:
A question in mathematics is given to three students P, Q and R whose chances of solving are 1/3, 1/4, 1/5 respectively. What is the probability
that the problem will be solved?
textHi: गणित में एक प्रश्न तीन छात्रों P, Q और R को दिया जाता है जिनके हल होने की संभावना 1/3, 1/4, 1/5 है, क्या प्रायिकता है कि समस्या हल हो जाएगी?

explanation.text:
The problem is solved if **at least one** student solves it. Work out the probability that nobody solves it, then subtract from 1.

- P(P fails) = 1 − 1/3 = 2/3
- P(Q fails) = 1 − 1/4 = 3/4
- P(R fails) = 1 − 1/5 = 4/5

The students work independently, so:
P(none solves) = 2/3 × 3/4 × 4/5 = 24/60 = 2/5 = 0.4

P(problem solved) = 1 − 0.4 = **0.6**

Why not the others: 0.4 is the probability that nobody solves it. 0.8 and 0.7 do not come from the correct working.

text: If f(1) = 4 and f(5) = 6, then what is the value of f(3) using Lagrange’s interpolation?
textHi: यदि f(1) = 4 और f(5) = 6, तो लैग्रेंज के अंतरवेषन का उपयोग करके f(3) का मान क्या है?

explanation.text:
With two points, Lagrange's formula gives a straight line.

Points: x₀ = 1, f(x₀) = 4 and x₁ = 5, f(x₁) = 6.

f(x) = f(x₀)·(x − x₁)/(x₀ − x₁) + f(x₁)·(x − x₀)/(x₁ − x₀)

At x = 3:
- First term: 4 × (3 − 5)/(1 − 5) = 4 × (−2)/(−4) = 4 × 0.5 = 2
- Second term: 6 × (3 − 1)/(5 − 1) = 6 × 2/4 = 3

f(3) = 2 + 3 = **5**

Check: x = 3 is exactly halfway between 1 and 5, so the linear value is the average of 4 and 6, which is 5.

text: In Hindi every noun can have ______ forms in principle.
textHi: हिन्दी में हर संज्ञा के सिद्धांत में ______ प्रकार होते हैं।

explanation.text:
A Hindi noun changes for **number** and **case**:
- Number: singular and plural (2)
- Case form: direct (मूल), oblique (तिर्यक) and vocative (संबोधन) (3)

2 × 3 = **6** forms are possible in principle. For example, लड़का:
- Direct: लड़का (sg), लड़के (pl)
- Oblique: लड़के (sg, as in लड़के को), लड़कों (pl, as in लड़कों को)
- Vocative: लड़के (sg), लड़को (pl)

In practice several of these look the same (लड़के appears three times), and many nouns, such as feminine nouns or nouns ending in a consonant, show even fewer distinct forms. That is why the question says "in principle". The 6 slots exist for every noun, even when some forms coincide.

options.label: D
options.textHi: ना तो I, ना तो II

explanation.text:
**Intermediate goods** are goods used up as inputs in producing other goods and services during the same period. They are **not final goods**, because they are not bought by final users for consumption or investment. Their value is already included in the value of the final product, so national income counts only final goods to avoid **double counting**. Statement I is correct.

Steel sheets bought by a car manufacturer are used up in making automobiles, so they are a standard textbook example of intermediate goods. Statement II is correct.

(The same steel bought by a household for its own use would be a final good. What matters is how the good is used, not what it is.)

text: In a concave mirror, when object is at inflinity then image is ______.
textHi: अवतल दर्णण में, जब बिंब अनंत पर होता है तो प्रतिबिंब ______ होता है।

explanation.text:
When an object is at infinity, rays from it reach the mirror **parallel to the principal axis**. After reflection, a concave mirror makes parallel rays converge at its **principal focus (F)**. So the image forms **at F**. It is real, inverted and highly diminished (point-sized).

Image positions for a concave mirror:
- Object at infinity → image at F
- Object beyond C → image between F and C
- Object at C → image at C
- Object between C and F → image beyond C
- Object at F → image at infinity

("inflinity" in the question is a printed typo for "infinity".)

options.textHi: ना ही I ना ही II

concept: Order of static, sliding, rolling friction

explanation.text:
For the same surfaces, the forces of friction compare as:

**static friction > sliding friction > rolling friction**

- It takes more force to *start* moving an object (static friction) than to keep it sliding (sliding or kinetic friction). So "sliding friction > static friction" is wrong.
- Rolling friction is much smaller than sliding friction. This is why wheels and ball bearings are used to make motion easier. So "rolling friction > sliding friction" is also wrong.

Both statements reverse the true order, so neither is correct.

text: In a certain code language, ‘VENUE’ is written as ‘LBULC’. What is the code for ‘TEMPO’ in that code language?
textHi: एक विशिष्ट कोड भाषा में, ‘VENUE’ को ‘LBULC’ लिखा जाता है। इस कोड भाषा में ‘TEMPO’ का कोड क्या है?

explanation.text:
Write VENUE backwards: **E U N E V**. Now move each letter 7 places forward (A = 1, wrapping after Z):
- E(5) + 7 = 12 → L
- U(21) + 7 = 28 → 2 → B
- N(14) + 7 = 21 → U
- E(5) + 7 = 12 → L
- V(22) + 7 = 29 → 3 → C

This gives **LBULC**, which matches.

Do the same for TEMPO. Reversed it is **O P M E T**:
- O(15) + 7 = 22 → V
- P(16) + 7 = 23 → W
- M(13) + 7 = 20 → T
- E(5) + 7 = 12 → L
- T(20) + 7 = 27 → 1 → A

The code is **VWTLA**.

text:
Seven girls L, M, N, P, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). M is second to
the right of N. N is third to the right of P. R is third to the right of S. L is third to the left of Q. S is not the immediate neighbour of M.
Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct?
I. Q is to the immediate left of N.
II. P is third to the left of N.
textHi:
सात लड़कियाँ L, M, N, P, Q, R तथा S कें द्र की ओर मुख करके एक वृत्ताकार मेज के इर्द-गिर्द बैठी हुई हैं (जरूरी नहीं की इसी क्रम में हो)। M, N के दायीं
ओर दूसरे स्थान पर है। N, P के दायीं ओर तीसरे स्थान पर है। R, S के दायीं ओर तीसरे स्थान पर है। L, Q के बायीं ओर तीसरे स्थान पर है। S, M का निकटतम
पड़ोसी नहीं है।
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
I. Q, N के तुरंत बायीं ओर है।
II. P, N के बायीं ओर तीसरे स्थान पर है।

options.label: D
options.textHi: ना ही I ना ही II

explanation.text:
Number the seats 0–6 going to the right (left = −1).
- Put P at 0. N is 3rd to the right of P, so N = 3. M is 2nd to the right of N, so M = 5.
- Seats 1, 2, 4 and 6 are left for L, Q, R and S.
- R = S + 3 (mod 7): (S = 1, R = 4) or (S = 6, R = 2). S is not next to M (seats 4, 6), so S = 1, R = 4.
- L is 3rd to the left of Q, so L = Q − 3. With seats 2 and 6 left, Q = 2 and L = 6 (2 − 3 = −1 ≡ 6).

Going right: P0, S1, Q2, N3, R4, M5, L6.

- **I.** Immediately left of N (seat 3) is seat 2, **Q**. True.
- **II.** Third left of N is seat 0, **P**. True.

Both statements are correct.

text:
A3B means B is wife of A. A5B means B is sister of A. A7B means B is mother of A. A9B means B is father of A. In A9B3C5D, what is the
relation of D with A?
textHi:
A3B का अर्थ B, A की पत्नी है। A5B का अर्थ B, A की बहन है। A7B का अर्थ B, A की माता है। A9B का अर्थ B, A का पिता है। A9B3C5D में, D का A से
क्या रिश्ता है?

explanation.text:
Decode **A9B3C5D** one step at a time:
- **A9B:** B is the father of A.
- **B3C:** C is the wife of B. B is A's father, so C is A's **mother**.
- **C5D:** D is the sister of C. So D is the sister of A's mother.

A's mother's sister is A's **aunt** (maternal aunt, *mausi*).

D is female (a sister), and she belongs to A's parents' generation. That rules out mother, daughter and niece.

text:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements
to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given
conclusion logically follows the given statements.
Statements:
I. Some P are K.
II. No S is P.
Conclusions:
I. No P is S.
II. All S are K.
textHi:
नीचे दिए गए प्रश्न में कुछ कथन और उनके बाद उन कथनों पर आधारित कुछ निष्कर्ष दिए गए हैं। दिए गए कथनों को सही माने, चाहे उनमें सामान्य ज्ञात तथ्यों
से भिन्नता हो। सभी निष्कर्ष पढ़ें और फिर निर्धारित करें कि दिए गए कौन से निष्कर्ष, दिए गए कथनों के आधार पर युक्तिसंगत हैं।
कथन:
I. कुछ P, K हैं।
II. कोई भी S, P नहीं है।
निष्कर्ष:
I. कोई भी P, S नहीं है।
II. सभी S, K हैं।

options.label: A
options.textHi: केवल निष्कर्ष I अनुसरण करता है

options.label: B
options.textHi: केवल निष्कर्ष II अनुसरण करता है

options.label: C
options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows
options.textHi: दोनों निष्कर्ष I तथा II अनुसरण करते ह

options.label: D
options.textHi: कोई भी निष्कर्ष अनुसरण नहीं करता है

explanation.text:
Statements: Some P are K, No S is P.
- **Conclusion I (No P is S):** a universal negative converts fully. 'No S is P' means the two groups share no member, which is the same as 'No P is S'. It follows.
- **Conclusion II (All S are K):** S is only known to be separate from P. S may lie completely outside K, partly inside it or fully inside it. Nothing forces all S to be K, so it does not follow.

So **only conclusion I follows** (option A), which matches the key.

concept: Wrong term: multiply by increasing factor

explanation.text:
Each term is the previous term multiplied by a factor that grows by 0.5 each time:
- 9 × 1 = 9
- 9 × 1.5 = 13.5
- 13.5 × 2 = **27**
- 27 × 2.5 = 67.5
- 67.5 × 3 = 202.5

The series has **28** where 27 should be. The terms after it (67.5 and 202.5) fit 27, not 28: 28 × 2.5 = 70, not 67.5. So 28 is the wrong term.

text:
Saroj walks 24 km towards north. She turns right and walks 20 km. She turns left and walks 30 km. She rotates by 90 degrees in clockwise
direction and walks 15 km. she turns right and walks 30 km. She finally rotates by 90 degrees in clockwise direction and walks 25 km. How far
and in which direction is her starting point from the finishing point?
textHi:
सरोज उत्तर की ओर 24 कि.मी. चलती है। वह दायीं ओर मुड़ती है तथा 20 कि.मी. चलती है। वह बायीं ओर मुड़ती है तथा 30 कि.मी. चलती है। वह 90 डिग्री से
दक्षिणावर्त दिशा में घूमती है तथा 15 कि.मी. चलती है। वह दायीं ओर मुड़ती है तथा 30 कि.मी. चलती है। वह अंततः 90 डिग्री से दक्षिणावर्त दिशा में घूमती है
तथा 25 कि.मी. चलती है। उसकी प्रारंभिक बिंदु अंतिम बिंदु से कितनी दूरी पर तथा किस दिशा में है?

explanation.text:
Start at (0, 0) facing north. East is +x, north is +y.
1. North 24 km → (0, 24)
2. Turn right (now facing east), 20 km → (20, 24)
3. Turn left (facing north), 30 km → (20, 54)
4. Turn 90° clockwise (facing east), 15 km → (35, 54)
5. Turn right (facing south), 30 km → (35, 24)
6. Turn 90° clockwise (facing west), 25 km → (10, 24)

She finishes at (10, 24). The start (0, 0) is 10 km west and 24 km south of this point.

Distance = √(10² + 24²) = √676 = **26 km**.

Direction of the starting point from the finishing point: **South-west**.

- Square: 3 characters (#, #, 7); dashes 1 + 4 + 2 + 2 = **9 = 3²**

- (D) 1 symbol (@); dashes 1 + 1 + 2 = 4, not 1.

text:
A student reads 4/9 of a book on a day and 9/10 of the rest on the second day. The number of pages still unread are 60.
How many pages does the book contain?

explanation.text:
Let the book have x pages.
- Day 1: reads 4/9 of x, so the rest is 5x/9.
- Day 2: reads 9/10 of the rest, so the unread part is 1/10 of the rest.
- Unread = (1/10) × (5x/9) = 5x/90 = **x/18**.
Given x/18 = 60, so x = **1080**, option (B).
Check: Day 1 = 4/9 × 1080 = 480, leaving 600. Day 2 = 9/10 × 600 = 540, leaving 60. ✓
The common mistake is to take 9/10 of the whole book instead of 9/10 of the remainder.

text: Average of a and b is 42. Average of b and c is 56. Average c and a is 48. What is the average of a, b and c?

Turn each average into a sum:

- b + c = 2 × 56 = 112
- c + a = 2 × 48 = 96

Add the three equations: 2(a + b + c) = 84 + 112 + 96 = 292
So a + b + c = 146.

Average of a, b and c = 146 ÷ 3 = **48.67**, which the options give as 48.66 (truncated).

Shortcut: the average of the three numbers equals the average of the three pair averages: (42 + 56 + 48)/3 = 146/3 ≈ 48.67.

A = (62 ÷ 434) × 100

Notice that 434 = 7 × 62, so 62/434 = 1/7.

A = 100/7 = **14.28** (more exactly 14.2857…)

Check: 14.28% of 434 ≈ 0.1428 × 434 ≈ 62.

Fraction equivalents worth remembering: 1/6 = 16.66%, 1/8 = 12.5%, 1/7 = 14.28%. Spotting that 434 is an exact multiple of 62 saves doing a long division.

text:
A’s salary is 50 percent of B’s salary. If A’s salary is increased by 60 percent and B’s salary is decreased by 20 percent, then A’s salary will be
how much percentage of B’s salary?
textHi:
A का वेतन B के वेतन का 50 प्रतिशत है। यदि A का वेतन 60 प्रतिशत से बढ़ाया जाता है तथा B का वेतन 20 प्रतिशत से कम किया जाता है, तो A का वेतन B
के वेतन का कितना प्रतिशत होगा?

explanation.text:
Let B's salary be 100. Then A's salary = 50% of 100 = 50.

After the changes:
- A's new salary = 50 + 60% of 50 = 50 × 1.6 = **80**
- B's new salary = 100 − 20% of 100 = 100 × 0.8 = **80**

A's salary as a percentage of B's = (80/80) × 100 = **100 percent**.

So after the changes, both earn the same amount.

text:
Cost price of 10 articles is equal to the selling price of 12 articles. What is the profit/loss percentage? (Cost price of all articles is same and selling
price of all articles is same)
textHi:
10 वस्तुओं का क्रय मुल्य 12 वस्तुओं के विक्रय मूल्य के समान है। लाभ/हानि प्रतिशत क्या है? (सभी वस्तुओं का क्रय मूल्य समान है तथा सभी वस्तुओं का विक्रय
मूल्य समान है)
concept: CP of x equals SP of y

explanation.text:
Let the cost price of one article be ₹1. Then CP of 10 articles = ₹10.

This equals the SP of 12 articles, so SP of 1 article = 10/12 = ₹5/6.

SP (5/6) is less than CP (1), so there is a **loss**.

Loss on one article = 1 − 5/6 = 1/6
Loss % = (1/6) ÷ 1 × 100 = **16.66%**

Shortcut: loss % = (12 − 10)/12 × 100 = 16.66%. When the cost of x articles equals the selling price of y articles and y > x, it is a loss of (y − x)/y × 100.

text: The ratio of three numbers is 2 : 3 : 6 and the sum of their square is 441. What is the value of the largest of the three numbers?

explanation.text:
Let the numbers be 2k, 3k and 6k.

Sum of squares: (2k)² + (3k)² + (6k)² = 4k² + 9k² + 36k² = 49k²

49k² = 441, so k² = 9 and k = 3.

The numbers are 6, 9 and 18. The largest is 6k = **18**.

text: What is that rate of simple interest at which a sum of money becomes three times of itself in 48 years?
textHi: साधारण ब्याज की वह दर क्या है जिस पर कोई राशि 48 वषीं में स्वयं की तिगुनी हो जाती है?

explanation.text:
If a sum becomes 3 times itself, the amount is 3P, so the simple interest is 3P − P = **2P**.

SI = P × R × T / 100
2P = P × R × 48 / 100
R = 200/48 = **4.1667% ≈ 4.17%**

General formula: if a sum becomes n times itself in T years at simple interest, R = (n − 1) × 100 / T. Here (3 − 1) × 100 / 48 = 4.17%.

text:
A man starts from a place A and reaches the place B in 16 hours. He travels 1/2 distance at the speed of 6 km/hr and the remaining distance at the
speed of 18 km/hr. What is the distance between A and B?
textHi:
एक व्यक्ति एक स्थान A से आरंभ करता है तथा स्थान B पर 16 घंटे में पहुँच जाता है। वह 1/2 दूरी को 6 कि.मी./घंटा की गति से तय करता है तथा शेष दूरी 18
कि.मी./घंटा की गति से तय करता है। A तथा B के बीच की दूरी क्या है?

explanation.text:
Let the total distance be d km. Each half is d/2 km.

Time for the first half = (d/2) ÷ 6 = d/12
Time for the second half = (d/2) ÷ 18 = d/36

Total time: d/12 + d/36 = 16
(3d + d)/36 = 16
4d = 576
d = **144 km**

Check: 72 km at 6 km/h takes 12 h, and 72 km at 18 km/h takes 4 h. Total 16 h ✓

Alternative: the average speed for equal distances is 2 × 6 × 18/(6 + 18) = 9 km/h, so d = 9 × 16 = 144 km.

text:
Which of the following statement is correct?
I. A starts from point P at 8:00 am with speed of 45 km/hr. B starts from point P at 10:00 am at 60 km/hr towards A. B will catch A at 4:00 pm.
II. If A increases his speed by 25 percent, then he covers the same distance in 20 percent less time.
textHi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन सही है?
I. A, 45 कि.मी./घंटा की गति से बिंदु P से 8:00 पूर्वाह्न पर चलना शुरू करता है। B, 60 कि.मी./घंटा की गति से बिंदु P से 10:00 पूर्वाह्न पर A की ओर चलना
शुरू करता है। B, A को 4:00 अपराह्न पर पकड़ लेगा।
II. यदि A अपनी गति को 25 प्रतिशत से बढ़ाता है, तो वह समान दूरी को 20 प्रतिशत कम समय में तय करता है।

options.label: D
options.textHi: ना ही I ना ही II

explanation.text:
**Statement I:** A starts at 8:00 am at 45 km/h. By 10:00 am, A is 2 × 45 = 90 km ahead.
B starts at 10:00 am at 60 km/h. The relative speed is 60 − 45 = 15 km/h.
Time to catch up = 90 ÷ 15 = 6 hours, so B catches A at 10:00 am + 6 h = **4:00 pm**. True.

**Statement II:** For a fixed distance, time ∝ 1/speed.
New speed = 1.25 × old speed, so new time = old time ÷ 1.25 = 0.8 × old time.
The time falls by **20%**. True.

Both statements are correct.

matches.reason: Both include the catch-up (relative speed) statement for B chasing A; other statements and answers differ.

सकते हैं?
concept: Efficiency ratio to time, combined work

explanation.text:
Efficiency P : Q = 120 : 100 = 6 : 5.
Time is inversely proportional to efficiency, so time P : Q = 5 : 6.
The difference of 1 part = 2 days, so P takes 5 × 2 = **10 days** and Q takes 6 × 2 = **12 days**.
Together, in one day: 1/10 + 1/12 = 6/60 + 5/60 = 11/60 of the work.
Time together = **60/11 days** (about 5.45 days), option (C).

text:
Area of a rhombus is 108 cm^2. If the sum of the length of its diagonals is 30 cm, then what will be the difference between the length of its
diagonal?
textHi: एक विषमकोण का क्षेत्रफल 108 से.मी.^2 है। यदि इसके विकणीं की लम्बाई का योग 30 से.मी. है, तो इसके विकणीं की लम्बाई के बीच का अंतर क्या होगा?
concept: Rhombus diagonals from area and sum

explanation.text:
Area of a rhombus = ½ × d₁ × d₂ = 108, so d₁ × d₂ = 216.

Given d₁ + d₂ = 30.

(d₁ − d₂)² = 900 − 864 = 36
d₁ − d₂ = **6 cm**

text: Area of the base of a cylinder is 346.5 cm. If total surface area of the cylinder is 2013 cm^2, then what will be the length of the cylinder?
textHi: एक बेलन के आधार का क्षेत्रफल 346.5 से.मी. है। यदि बेलन का कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 2013 से.मी.^2 है, तो बेलन की ऊँचाई क्या होगी?
concept: Cylinder height from base area and TSA

explanation.text:
Base area: πr² = 346.5 (the paper prints "cm" but means cm²).
r² = 346.5 × 7/22 = 110.25, so r = **10.5 cm**.

Total surface area = 2πr(r + h) = 2013.
2πr = 2 × 22/7 × 10.5 = 66
66 × (10.5 + h) = 2013
10.5 + h = 30.5
h = **20 cm**

Check: curved surface = 2πrh = 66 × 20 = 1320. The two bases = 2 × 346.5 = 693. Total = 2013 ✓

The bar graph given below shows the production of cars (in thousands) by two different companies P and Q over the years.
Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct?

textHi:
नीचे दिया गया दण्ड चित्र दो अलग-अलग कंपनियों P तथा Q द्वारा वषीं में कारों का उत्पादन (हजार में) दिखाता है।
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
I. 1991 से 1993 तक कंपनी P की कारों का उत्पादन 57.14 प्रतिशत बढ़ा।
II. 1994 में कंपनी P द्वारा कारों के उत्पादन का 1996 में कंपनी Q द्वारा कारों के उत्पादन से अनुपात 14 : 9 है।
III. 1991 से 1996 तक कंपनी P द्वारा कारों का औसत उत्पादन 61677 है।
concept: Bar graph percent change, ratio, average

explanation.text:
Company P (thousands): 35, 45, 55, 70, 45, 25 for 1991 to 1996. Company Q: 25, 75, 60, 75, 30, 45.
- **I:** P goes from 35 (1991) to 55 (1993). Increase = 20/35 × 100 = **57.14%**. True.
- **II:** P in 1994 = 70 and Q in 1996 = 45, so 70 : 45 = **14 : 9**. True.
- **III:** Average of P = (35 + 45 + 55 + 70 + 45 + 25)/6 = 275/6 ≈ 45.83 thousand ≈ **45833**, not 61677. False.

text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द विदेशज है?
textHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द विदेशज है?

explanation.text:
जो शब्द विदेशी भाषाओं (अरबी, फ़ारसी, तुर्की, अंग्रेज़ी, पुर्तगाली आदि) से हिंदी में आए हैं, वे **विदेशज** कहलाते हैं। **कुर्सी** अरबी भाषा से आया शब्द है, इसलिए यह विदेशज है। इसी प्रकार किताब, कलम, अदालत (अरबी) और स्कूल, डॉक्टर (अंग्रेज़ी) भी विदेशज शब्द हैं।
अन्य विकल्प:
- तोंद और बक-बक: ये लोक-व्यवहार से बने देशज शब्द हैं (बक-बक ध्वनि-अनुकरण पर आधारित है)।
- लाला: परीक्षा-सूचियों में इसे प्रायः देशज शब्दों में गिना जाता है, यद्यपि इसकी व्युत्पत्ति पर मत भिन्न हैं।
इस प्रश्न में स्पष्ट विदेशज शब्द **कुर्सी** है, अतः उत्तर विकल्प (D) है।

- द्विगु: पहला पद संख्यावाचक नहीं है।

निराहार
textHi:
दिए गए शब्द की संधि विच्छेद ज्ञात कीजिए।
निराहार

explanation.text:
**निराहार = निः + आहार** (विसर्ग संधि)।
नियम: यदि विसर्ग से पहले 'इ' या 'उ' हो और बाद में कोई स्वर (या घोष व्यंजन) आए, तो विसर्ग 'र्' में बदल जाता है। यहाँ निः + आहार में विसर्ग के बाद 'आ' स्वर है, इसलिए निर् + आहार = निराहार (बिना भोजन के)।
इसी प्रकार के उदाहरण: निः + आशा = निराशा, निः + आधार = निराधार, दुः + आचार = दुराचार।
अन्य विकल्प:
- नीः + हार और नीः + आहार: उपसर्ग 'निः' में छोटी 'इ' होती है, 'नी' नहीं।
- निः + हर: इससे 'निर्हर' जैसा रूप बनेगा और अर्थ भी नहीं बनता।
अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (B) है।

अन्य विकल्प:

- निर्दोष: इसका विलोम 'दोषी/सदोष' है।

दिया गया वाक्य किस पुरूष का उदाहरण है, ज्ञात कीजिए।

textHi:
दिया गया वाक्य किस पुरूष का उदाहरण है, ज्ञात कीजिए।
मोहन बहुत खाना खाता है।

explanation.text:
वाक्य 'मोहन बहुत खाना खाता है' में 'मोहन' के बारे में बात की जा रही है; वह न वक्ता है, न श्रोता। जिसके विषय में बात की जाए, वह **अन्य पुरुष** होता है। सभी संज्ञाएँ (मोहन, राम, लड़का) और वह/वे जैसे सर्वनाम अन्य पुरुष में आते हैं।
- उत्तम पुरुष: बोलने वाला (मैं, हम)।
- मध्यम पुरुष: सुनने वाला (तू, तुम, आप)।
- अन्य पुरुष: जिसके बारे में बात हो (वह, वे, मोहन)।
ध्यान दें: संस्कृत व्याकरण में 'प्रथम पुरुष' का अर्थ भी अन्य पुरुष होता है, पर हिंदी में मानक नाम 'अन्य पुरुष' है, इसलिए विकल्प (D) अपेक्षित उत्तर है।

aiCheck.note: Minor flaw: in Sanskrit grammar 'प्रथम पुरुष' denotes the third person, so option A overlaps in meaning; 'अन्य पुरुष' is the standard Hindi term and the intended answer.

explanation.text:
वाक्य "यहाँ सारी दुनिया के लोग ही आ गए क्या" में वक्ता कुछ पूछ रहा है। वाक्य के अंत में आया **"क्या"** इसे प्रश्नवाचक वाक्य बनाता है, इसलिए इसके अंत में **प्रश्नवाचक चिह्न (?)** लगेगा: "यहाँ सारी दुनिया के लोग ही आ गए क्या?"

अन्य विकल्प क्यों नहीं:
- **: (उपविराम/कोलन)** किसी बात को स्पष्ट करने या सूची आरंभ करने से पहले लगता है, वाक्य के अंत में नहीं।
- **! (विस्मयादिबोधक)** हर्ष, शोक, आश्चर्य आदि भाव प्रकट करने वाले शब्दों या वाक्यों के बाद लगता है; यहाँ मुख्य भाव प्रश्न का है।
- **। (पूर्ण विराम)** साधारण कथन (विधानवाचक वाक्य) के अंत में लगता है, प्रश्न के अंत में नहीं।

textHi:
निम्नलिखित प्रश्न में, दिए गए चार विकल्पों में से, उस विकल्प का चयन करें जो दिए गए मुहावरे के अर्थ को सर्वश्रेष्ठ रूप से व्यक्त करता है।
गंगा लाभ होना

explanation.text:
"गंगा लाभ होना" एक शिष्ट (मृदु) प्रयोग है, जिसका अर्थ है **मर जाना / मृत्यु होना**। हिंदू मान्यता में गंगा-तट पर या गंगा-स्मरण के साथ प्राण त्यागना पुण्य और मोक्षदायक माना जाता है, इसलिए किसी की मृत्यु को आदरपूर्वक "गंगा लाभ होना" कहा जाता है।

स्रोत उत्तर-कुंजी विकल्प D "मृत्यु के पश्चात् मोक्ष" को सही मानती है, जो इसी धार्मिक भाव को व्यक्त करता है। किंतु प्रचलित शब्दकोशों और मुहावरा-सूचियों में "गंगालाभ" का सीधा अर्थ **मृत्यु** दिया जाता है, जो विकल्प B "मृत्यु होना" है। इसलिए यह प्रश्न विवादास्पद है: B और D दोनों मृत्यु से जुड़े हैं और दोनों के पक्ष में तर्क दिया जा सकता है। परीक्षा के लिए उत्तर-कुंजी का उत्तर D याद रखें।

- "किसी कार्य से मुक्ति पाना" और "मारे-मारे फिरना" इस मुहावरे के अर्थ नहीं हैं।

text:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.
Onions are most water, (1)/ plus some vitamins (2)/ and sugar compounds. (3)/ No error (4)

explanation.text:
The error is in part (1), "Onions are **most** water". The sentence means that onions consist *mainly* of water. That calls for the adverb **mostly**: "Onions are **mostly** water, plus some vitamins and sugar compounds."

**Most** is used as a determiner or for the superlative ("most onions", "the most water"). It cannot mean "for the greater part" in this position.

Parts (2) and (3), "plus some vitamins and sugar compounds", are correct.

improvement.
Both sides then agreed to shift the wedding venue to a place convenience to all.

explanation.text:
The underlined word "convenience" is a **noun**. Here we need an **adjective** to describe "a place", so it must be **convenient**.

"A place **convenient to** all" is a standard expression meaning a place suitable for everyone. It keeps the sentence's original preposition, so option A fixes the error with the smallest change: "Both sides then agreed to shift the wedding venue to a place convenient to all."

Why not the others:
- **convenient for:** also used in English ("convenient for everyone"), but the key's option keeps the original preposition. Most grammar keys treat "convenient to all" as the expected correction.
- **convenience for:** still a noun, so the error remains.
- **No improvement:** wrong, because a noun cannot modify "place" here.

text:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select No
improvement.
I am yet to seen that series yet.

explanation.text:
The structure **be + yet + to-infinitive** expresses something that has not happened so far: "I am yet to see…" means "I have not seen… so far". After "to", the verb must be in its **base form**: *to see*, not *to seen* or *to watching*.

So the underlined part becomes "**yet to see**": "I am yet to see that series."

Why not the others:
- **yet to view:** grammatical, but it changes the original verb "see" for no reason. The minimal correction is "yet to see".
- **yet to watching:** wrong, because "to" + -ing is not used here.

(The second "yet" at the end of the printed sentence is redundant. It is outside the part being replaced.)

There is always an ______ to a stated theory.

The phrase "an **exception** to" a rule or theory means a case that does not follow it. "There is always an exception to a stated theory" is a complete, meaningful sentence. "An" also fits, since *exception* begins with a vowel sound.

Why not the others:
- **enemity:** misspelt (correct form *enmity*), and "an enmity to a theory" makes no sense.
- **eulogy:** a speech praising someone (often at a funeral). It does not fit.
- **placid:** an adjective meaning calm. It cannot follow "an" here without a noun.

text:
A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate word/words. Choose the correct alternative.
______ behalf of her son, she took the award.

explanation.text:
The fixed phrase is "**on behalf of**", meaning *representing* or *in place of* someone. "**On** behalf of her son, she took the award" means she accepted the award for him.

"In behalf of" is an old or chiefly American variant meaning "in the interest of". "At behalf" and "with behalf" are not used. The standard answer is **On**. A similar fixed phrase is "on account of", meaning *because of*.

text:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.
Human rights are rights
P: consequence of inherent human vulnerability, or because
Q: that belong to an individual or group of
R: they are requisite to the possibility of a just society
S: individuals simply for being human, or as a

explanation.text:
Start: "Human rights are rights…"
- **Q:** "that belong to an individual or group of". "Rights that belong to…" follows the opening naturally and ends with "group of".
- **S:** "individuals simply for being human, or as a". "Group of individuals" completes Q, and S ends with "as a".
- **P:** "consequence of inherent human vulnerability, or because". "As a consequence of…" completes S, and P ends with "because".
- **R:** "they are requisite to the possibility of a just society". This completes "because…".

Full sentence: "Human rights are rights that belong to an individual or group of individuals simply for being human, or as a consequence of inherent human vulnerability, or because they are requisite to the possibility of a just society."

Order: **QSPR**.

- **Parasite:** an organism, or a person, that lives off another.
- **Fanatic:** a person with excessive zeal.

text: In the given question, four words are given out of which one word is correctly spelt. Choose the correctly spelt word.

explanation.text:
The correct spelling is **Shopping**.

Rule: in a one-syllable word ending in a single vowel + single consonant (shop), double the final consonant before adding a suffix that begins with a vowel (-ing, -ed, -er). So: shop → sho**pp**ing, shopped, shopper.

Why not the others:
- **Shoppeng:** wrong ending (-eng instead of -ing).
- **Soping:** missing the "h" and the doubled "p".
- **Shoping:** missing the doubled "p". Without it the word would be pronounced like "shope-ing".

text: What can be the suitable title for the given passage?
passage:
Read the following information carefully and answer the given questions.
Seen by the courts as cruelty on bulls, but celebrated in Tamil Nadu as a display of valour, the rural sport of Jallikattu is an inevitable part of the
Pongal season in the State. It is promoted as a tourist attraction by the government and its appeal as a symbol of Tamil culture remains the same
year after year. It is only the odd voice that sees it as a relic of a feudal past. However, one aspect that remains unchanged - through the years in
which the legality of the bull-taming sport was questioned, the event itself banned, and then restored by law- is that every season, it leaves a few
dead and scores wounded. Often, these wounds are a trauma doctor’s nightmare, given the grievous nature of the bull gore injuries.
It is an event that cries for maximum regulation. The regulations have been tightened from time to time, and no event takes place without official
permission or medical supervision. The playing arena is protected by double barricades, the entry point and ‘collection point’, where the bulls are
to be taken back by the owners after they leave the arena, are supposed to have sufficient protective features to minimize incidents that lead to
injuries and fatalities. Yet, some have died in the main events that took place in the last few days; they include bull owners, spectators and an
organizer. The victims were mostly gored or stomped upon. Over a hundred are being treated for injuries, some of which are quite serious,
marked by internal ruptures that may have a lasting effect on the victims.
Question Number : 96 Question Id : 54062617411 Question Type : MCQ Option Shuffling : Yes Is Question Mandatory : No Option

explanation.text:
The passage is entirely about **Jallikattu**, the bull-taming sport of Tamil Nadu. It notes that courts see the sport as cruelty to bulls while Tamil Nadu celebrates it as a display of valour. It describes the deaths and serious gore injuries every season, and the regulations meant to limit them. A title naming Jallikattu and contrasting views of it, "**Jallikatu: Humdrum or fun**", is the only fitting choice.

Why not the others:
- **Meritocracy:** rule by merit.
- **Thalassocracy:** maritime supremacy.
- **Theocracy:** rule by religious authority.

These three are words for systems of government and do not relate to the passage at all.

aiCheck.note: In the extracted data the passage is attached to the last sub-question (q100), not this one. Options B–D (Meritocracy, Thalassocracy, Theocracy) have nothing to do with the passage, so A is the only sensible title.
